cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Take a brush for the picnic crumbs; we'll use the route it gives us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. Can I put the sandwiches down and try the front door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep them with you. This route saves us carrying the picnic blanket downstairs. Take it from that shelf.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now we're at the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm. Are we eating here?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We are. Put them beside the wine to cool. This door has found us a picnic with a roof and a wine list. You choose the bottle; I'll choose when we leave.

reason: Make A control the route despite B alternatives, then accept B cellar picnic question as a hosting decision caused by the latest malfunction and food temperature.
